intent: Hold the iteration 1 reference geometry unchanged, as the Integrator asked, so the kd 0.4 controller result is read against a fixed platform. I am not changing any geometry this iteration, because five races have shown the score follows the controller on this layout. Expected result: a score that reflects the controller change alone, with geometry contributing no new variation. I am considering, without committing, a single untested dynamics change (wheel_track or mass) in a later iteration, but only if line_loss_events falls clearly below 1 per run and the controller is held fixed.
learning: Five races on this geometry (iterations 1, 4, 6, 7, 8) show the score tracks the controller: 69.32 under the iteration 1 controller, 61.77 at base_speed 1.15, and 56.44 with kd 0.4. The geometry has been reproducible, and line loss has stayed near 1 per run in every race. Next step: if the Integrator's controller work reduces line loss, keep this geometry; if not, the remaining untested levers are wheel_track and mass.
rationale: Iterations 1, 4, 6, 7 and 8 all used this geometry: five 12 mm sensors at x = -0.03, -0.015, 0, 0.015, 0.03 m, y = 0.05 m, on a 0.12 m track with 0.03 m wheels, 0.6 kg mass and a 0.16 x 0.14 m body. Scores were 69.32 (iterations 1, 4 and 6, same controller), 61.77 (iteration 7, base_speed 1.15) and 56.44 (iteration 8, kd 0.4). Only the controller changed across those races, so the geometry is reproducible and the score swings are controller-driven. Every geometry change I tested lowered the score: the 16 mm footprint (54.45, controller held), y = 0.03 m (59.64, controller held) and the ±0.04 m span (52.47, controller held). Line loss has stayed at about 1 per run (1.0 to 1.65) across every geometry, and steering oscillation (0.07 to 0.15) is not limiting. The Integrator's feedback asks me to hold this geometry while the kd test runs, and I take that advice. I considered testing an untried dynamics lever, such as wheel_track or mass. I am not doing it now, because it would confound the controller test that the Integrator is running on this geometry, and the evidence gives no direction for it. Body width does not move the off-track limit (max(0.06, 0.0125 + body_width/4) = 0.06 m across the allowed range), so I am not using it as a lever. Expected result: no geometry-driven change, with the score depending on the controller. If the kd 0.4 result shows line loss clearly below 1 per run, I can test one later geometry change in a subsequent iteration.
